headline: Postponed $900,000 from opioid settlement fund for Winter Warming Shelter at 166 Riverside Industrial Parkway until November 2.
summary: Council voted 8-0 to postpone a $900,000 appropriation from the Opioid Settlement Fund for an emergency winter warming shelter. Council also met in executive session about the shelter's property and legal matters.
decisions: Postponed to November 2, 2026, the $900,000 appropriation from the Opioid Settlement Fund for the Winter Warming Shelter, 8-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Order 70-26/27 Approving the Appropriation of $900,000 from the Opioid Settlement Fund for Operation of Emergency Winter Warming Shelter at 166 Riverside Industrial Parkway - Sponsored by Mark Dion, Mayor Motion was made by Councilor Sykes and seconded by Councilor Ali to postpone to the November 2, 2026 City Council Meeting. Passage: 8-0 (Councilor Fournier absent)

plain_text:
IN CITY COUNCIL REGULAR MEETING OCTOBER 26, 2026  VOL. 136 PAGE 1 
 
 
ZOOM INFORMATION:  
This meeting will be conducted remotely via Zoom pursuant to the Remote Meeting Policy adopted by the 
Portland City Council. If you are not able to attend live, a recording will be available in the Agenda Center 
following the meeting. 
 
https://portlandmaine-gov.zoom.us/j/84450123846?pwd=3Q2If8PG7ixXzea0TX5zn2IpMqSywR.1 
 
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: 
Mayor Dion waived the recitation of the Pledge of Allegiance 
ROLL CALL: 
Mayor Dion called the meeting to order at 5:05PM.  
Councilors Present: Councilor Fournier, Councilor Grant, Councilor Sykes, Councilor Pelletier, Councilor 
Michniewicz, Councilor Phillips, Mayor Dion 
(Councilors Ali and Bullett absent) (Councilor Ali joined 5:07, Councilor Bullett joined at 5:08) 
5:00 P.M. PUBLIC COMMENT PERIOD ON NON-AGENDA ITEMS: 
Motion made by Councilor Sykes and seconded by Councilor Michniewicz to suspend Council Rules 
eliminating non-agenda public comment for this meeting. Passage: 8-0 (Councilor Bullett absent) 
 The Mayor is expected to ask the Council to suspend the Council Rules, eliminating 
non-agenda public comment for this meeting. 
    
   
    
ANNOUNCEMENTS:  
ORDERS:  
 Order 70-26/27 Approving the Appropriation of $900,000 from the Opioid Settlement Fund for Operation of Emergency Winter Warming Shelter at 166 
Riverside Industrial Parkway - Sponsored by Mark Dion, Mayor 
    
  
Motion was made by Councilor Sykes and seconded by Councilor Ali to postpone to the 
November 2, 2026 City Council Meeting. Passage: 8-0 (Councilor Fournier absent) 
Mayor Dion opened the floor for Public Comment. The following individuals spoke: No 
one spoke 
    
EXECUTIVE SESSION:  
 
Pursuant to 1 M.R.S.§ 405(6)(C) and (E), the City Council may enter executive 
session to discuss the condition, acquisition, or use of real property for, or to consult 
with its attorneys concerning the City’s legal rights and duties with respect to the 
Winter Warming Shelter. 
    
  
*Item taken out of order immediately following the elimination of Public Comment on 
non-agenda items 
 
Motion to adjourn to Executive Session was made by Councilor Ali and seconded by 
Councilor Phillips for passage. Passage: 9-0  
Mayor Dion opened the floor for Public Comment. The following individuals spoke: 
Steven Scharf (Brackett St), Michael Hayes, Dena Libner (Assistant City Manager), 
Michael Goldman (Corporation Counsel)
IN CITY COUNCIL REGULAR MEETING OCTOBER 26, 2026  VOL. 136 PAGE 2 
 
 
 
*Executive Session adjourned at 6:12 and City Council Meeting reconvened  
    
ADJOURNMENT: 
Motion was made by Councilor Sykes and seconded by Councilor Phillips to adjourn to. Passage: 8-0 
(Councilor Fournier absent) 
Adjourned 6:18PM 
 
A TRUE RECORD 
 
____________________________________ 
 
Abbey Lombard, City Clerk
